x: Pascoe, who has had a very successful season in Open Mile Handicaps, having gained a place in each one held, finished third just in front of Bryan.

Pascoe taking third place for the North. In the 3 Miles the South were represented by Frank Abberton and Harry Shields, who has now taken over the track captain's job, as Frank Webb has been called up to the Forces.
Pascoe, of N.L.H., ran well in beating Fred White in the 880 Yards with a newcomer in Sergt.
Pascoe the North Londoner ran one of his great races to beat both Carter and Cohen in the 2 miles. There were no outstanding performances in the field events, although the competitors were very keen.
